text:
noah: Quick heads-up  we need a compact roadmap blurb for routing policies + multi-region + tenant isolation for next week's investor demo. Can we agree on priorities and measurable launch gates?

alicja: Suggest three pillars: compliance (region-residency), latency (APAC edge), isolation (reserved pools & eviction policy). Keep gates measurable.

devin: For measurable gates: residency = end-to-end data + logs in-region; latency = p50/p95 targets per metro; isolation = tenant CPU/memory steal thresholds + isolation SLA.

sam: Rollout stages: seed (1 internal + 1 customer), cohort (5 customers, runtime flags), public (self-serve + SLA). Each stage needs a checklist: infra, legal, billing, evals.

noah: Evals note: automated synthetic eval suite must run on each model variant used at edge/shield. Gate = no >5% regression in primary metric.

ops-bot: deploy-health: can emit region-latency, error-rate, egress-by-customer. Recommend pre-cutover 24h residency scan.

alicja: Pricing idea: residency = compliance fee; edge = reservation + usage; isolation = paid tier with minimum commit. Add it to the slide.

devin: Risks to call out: cost of POPs, missing model variants on quantized infra, and migration friction for customer endpoints.

sam: Action items:
- noah: one-slide summary + acceptance bullets (Wed)
- alicja: cost delta sketch for APAC edge (Tue)
- devin: synthetic eval spec (Tue)
- ops: residency verification job + dashboard templates (Thu)

noah: OK will draft and post. If anyone wants different thresholds speak now.
